dial-inbound.text: Please enter or say your 12-digit agent pairing code. If you enter it on your keypad, press star when you’re done.

dial-inbound-retry.text: Sorry, that Agent Pairing Code did not connect. Say all 12 digits, then pause. Or enter all 12 digits on your keypad and press star.

dial-repeat.text: Welcome back. I’ve sent a secure verification request to your trusted device. Confirm it with Face ID, Touch ID, or your passkey to continue. To use a new Agent Pairing Code instead, press hash.

dial-acceptance.text: Hi, this is Rafii, your AI assistant. Press one to connect, or simply hang up to decline.
